module: Editor extension that displays a "World Editor News" modal window with the important release notes, only once per message version (EditorNewsMessageVersion = 5), with links to the BeamNG support and forum. It remembers the display in two hidden preferences (newsMessage.general.newsMessageShown and newsMessageVersion).
notes: In 0.40.5, newsText is empty: onEditorGui returns immediately and the window is never displayed.
For the message to be displayed again, EditorNewsMessageVersion must be increased and newsText filled in.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: opens the modal window if the message has not yet been seen for this version, then draws it (text, links, Close button).

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Preferences registration hook: creates the newsMessage category with the hidden preferences newsMessageShown (bool) and newsMessageVersion (int).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the "newsModalDlg" modal window.
